Strategy: Mean-anchored residual choice. Prefer the bin whose residual is closest to the mean of the currently feasible residuals, with a slight tilt toward tighter fits. The choice differs from Best Fit whenever the tightest bin sits far below the mean while another bin sits near it. It may help by keeping residuals balanced so bins fill evenly instead of stranding one nearly empty bin, but may fail because even filling is weaker than tight filling when item sizes vary.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    m = sum(bins) / len(bins)
    return [-abs(r - m) - 0.05 * (r - item) for r in bins]
```
